# AstryxBreadcrumbs { #anylumino.AstryxBreadcrumbs }

```python
AstryxBreadcrumbs(items, **props)
```

Render Astryx breadcrumbs from item records.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Default    |
|---------|-----------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| items   | Iterable\[Any\] | Item records used by generated child components or static search sources.                                                                                                                                                     | _required_ |
| **props | Any             | JSON-safe Breadcrumbs props. Useful keys: separator, variant, label, className, and style. anylumino generates breadcrumb children from items. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Breadcrumbs>. | `{}`       |
